science: Root derived the prototype, read actual final apparatus, source, oracle, independent boundary reference, validator, AUTHOR, scientific/local reports and final peer. Exact first-order unsteady Stokes and geometric moving-wall response are retained; convective momentum transport contributes at the same quadratic order as the requested pumping.
public_input_review: Anchored extensible material motion, no slip at the actual sheet, Newtonian incompressible Navier-Stokes liquid, no imposed pressure gradient or distant shear/counterflow, complex phase, units and stationary/far-field/amplitude limit order specify the experiment. No corrective formula or solver mandate. Exact unrestricted instruction and unfinished fit with None viscosity; private answers outside image.
calibration_review: 288 signed harmonic records at 72 settings with fixed sigma .002. Source and physical model coincide exactly on all calibration inputs at every viscosity. Identity u+i*v=omega*exp(-s*h) gives global injectivity through magnitude; 25 full-range noiseless fits and objective grids support implementation.
grading_review: All 256 oracle draws pass; all completed shortcuts fail all three pumping groups. Oracle error at most .000153; source gap at least .9025 and full-range gap at least .6636 at ordinary .04 gate. Independent BVP in 24 cases agrees within 1.86e-9; depth/tolerance refinement, oscillatory power versus dissipation and mean momentum-flux checks pass. Local oracle 7/7 versus shortcut 4+3.
classification_caveat: Retaining the linear fluid approximation for the quadratic mean response is a physical failure. Recognizing convection but making phase, sign, algebra or implementation errors must be classified separately. The far-field laboratory flow does not require an extra particle-following correction.
domain_count_qualification: 12 structured controls including all extrema and an interior frequency, plus 12 random controls. The preserved prototype has 12 cases.
